notes.title: Community Tournament Sign-Ups Now Open
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that sign-ups for the [b]Combat Mission Cold War Community Tournament[/b] are officially open. The tournament will feature three [b]brand-new scenarios[/b] created by [b]UsuallyHapless[/b], based on your votes on our [url=https://discord.gg/rdJUuH6QA8]Discord[/url]. This is your chance to showcase your tactical skills on maps [b]crafted by the community for the community[/b].

[b]Round 1[/b] | Lattichdorf - [i]US and Soviet forces clash over village.[/i]

[b]Round 2[/b] | Moppin Up Rotchstadt - [i]A Soviet Category C formation mops up isolated US straggler.[/i]

[b]Round 3[/b] | Fuel Hike - [i]US mechanized infantry attacks Soviet refuleing point in the woods.[/i]

[b]Before joining the tournament, please take a moment and carefully read these instructions that are specific to all Combat Mission Tournaments[/b]:
 
[list]
[*] Please do not sign up for this tournament if you are not sure that you will be able to play all of the battles.
[*] Because of the way that Combat Mission’s original “play by email” system works, both game files have an in-game field for password protection of the file. This field should be left blank. For the US side the password has been selected before the battles were sent and that field is to be left blank. You can use a password for the Soviet side but it isn’t needed because the Tournament feature handles protection from cheating without using the in game system.
[*] The Tournament will have you playing 2 individual battles where you are playing both sides of the same battle. If you get into the game before your opponent, you will see 1 game turn to play. If your opponent has gotten there first then you will see 2 turn files and each turn thereafter should have 2 files.
[*] Once a tournament begins you will receive the files in the "Saved Game and PBEM"; drop menu under Automated PBEM++ In Progress. You will receive email notifications when your opponent has sent you turns. 
[*] You will need a Matrix user name and password to play any tournament (or PBEM++ battle). If you don't have one already you can get one [url=https://www.matrixgames.com/login]here[/url].
[/list]

[i]Please remember, [b]DO NOT ABANDON OR SURRENDER[/b] during a round, as this will render the scoring inaccurate. We are aware of the scoreboard bug and are actively working on a fix. We appreciate your patience and support as we resolve this issue.[/i]

Whether you're a seasoned veteran or a new player, this tournament is the perfect opportunity to face off against others in the community and experience new battlefield scenarios.

We can’t wait to see how you navigate these community-made maps. Head over to our [url=https://www.slitherine.com/tournaments]Tournament Page[/url] to [url=https://www.slitherine.com/tournaments/scores/1154]sign up now[/url].

notes.title: Community Scenario #3
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to share that the third and final map in our “[i]Choose Your Own Scenario[/i]” series is now complete. This map, titled "[b]Fuel Hike[/b]", [i]features US Mechanized Infantry launching an attack on a Soviet refueling point hidden in the woods[/i]. Like the previous two, this map was shaped by your votes on [url=https://discord.com/invite/8hBhcYrErE]Discord[/url], and the journey concludes with another fantastic creation by Usually Hapless.

In his latest video, you can see the full process behind this scenario, bringing you the last chapter of the "[i]Making of a Community Scenario[/i]" series.

[previewyoutube=0QlH7yLJZmQ;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re currently tweaking a few final elements, and in a few weeks, we’ll be kicking off the[b] Community Tournament[/b], where you’ll get the chance to play through all three maps that you helped create. Stay tuned for more details.

notes.title: Matrix Games is the new Home of Combat Mission
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are excited to announce the [b]acquisition of Battlefront[/b], the renowned developers behind the Combat Mission series. 

[h2]ELEVATING COMBAT MISSION'S LEGACY[/h2]
This strategic move underscores our commitment to the wargaming community and the legacy of Combat Mission—a franchise celebrated for its unmatched tactical and strategic depth. With [b]over 1 million copies sold worldwide[/b], Combat Mission remains a defining force in the genre, setting the standard for authentic warfare simulations.

[previewyoutube=u3OwoL7A4RE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]LOOKING FORWARD[/h2]
This acquisition marks a new chapter for Combat Mission, as we plan to enhance the series with cutting-edge technology and innovative gameplay, all while preserving the core elements that have made it a favorite among wargamers for [b]over 25 years[/b].

[b]Battlefront's entire team[/b], including the original creators, [b]will be joining Slitherine[/b], ensuring the continuity and quality that fans have come to expect.

This partnership makes a milestone in wargaming, with Slitherine and Battlefront committed to delivering the best possible experience and ensuring the continued growth and success of the Combat Mission franchise.

[h2]AVAILABILITY & DISTRIBUTION[/h2]
Combat Mission titles [b]will continue to be available[/b] on all current platforms, including Matrix Games and Steam. To help both new and existing players, we have updated our [url=https://www.matrixgames.com/battlefront-acquisition-faq]FAQ[/url] and "[url=https://www.matrixgames.com/combat-mission-how-to-download-my-games]How to Download My Games[/url]" sections, making it easier than ever to access and enjoy the series.

[h2]A DAY OF CELEBRATION[/h2]
To celebrate this exciting milestone, we're thrilled to offer [b]discounts of up to 60%[/b] on all Combat Mission titles. This is a [b]limited-time sale[/b], available until September 3rd, so don't miss out: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/combatmissionfranchisesale


Additionally, we have organized a full day of streaming on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/slitherinetv/schedule]Twitch channel[/url]. The schedule includes a variety of Combat Mission titles, showcasing gameplay and strategies. Join us to experience our streamers in action and engage with our community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772341/81576c3109a93360acd451e5856c3d135c4091e5.jpg[/img]

We are also pleased to announce the opening of subscriptions for a new Battle for Normandy [url=https://www.slitherine.com/tournaments]tournament[/url] featuring [b]three brand new maps[/b]. These maps have been meticulously crafted, all starting from the master map of the Battle Pack 2.

Enjoy this Combat Mission milestone and celebration and [b]don’t miss[/b] this perfect opportunity to expand your collection and dive into the acclaimed tactical warfare series at an unbeatable price.

notes.title: Combat Mission Cold War Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]Combat Mission Cold War Out Now![/b]
Take command of either US or Soviet tactical formations, centering on the Company Team or Battalion Task Force between 1979 to 1982.

[previewyoutube=DmzzFOFt5Io;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Combat Mission Cold War[/b] is set in the tipping-point years of a conflict that gripped the world for 45 years. Between 1979-1982, both the NATO and Soviet Warsaw Pact militaries began the shift away from industrialized warfare of the early 20th century and towards the modern digital battlefield of today. 

Combat Mission Cold War simulates several “what if” conflict scenarios between US and Soviet forces centered on the strategic Fulda Gap and environs in West Germany.  

[b]15 standalone scenarios [/b]set in the US V and VII Corp sectors of West Germany and [b]3 full length campaigns:[/b]
-The NTC Campaign:  Puts you in command of a US Army Company Team as it begins its rotation and trial by simulated fire against the premier Soviet style formation in the world.
-The US West German Campaign: Set in the southern Fulda Strategic Corridor between Fulda and Hanau (there are two versions of the US Campaign, 1982 and 1979 to allow players the opportunity   to see and compare the differences in equipment between the two periods).
-The Soviet Campaign: Set north and east of Fulda, the Soviet Campaign follows the “Ride of the 120th Motor Rifle Regt” on the opening 48 hours of a fictional “what if” West German invasion.

[b]Battlefront and Slitherine join forces to deliver the world’s most accurate cold war simulator to Steam and the Matrix Games store[/b]

notes.title: Combat Mission Cold War Out on November 16th
notes.content:
[b]November 16th[/b], are you ready for the battle? 
Take command of either US or Soviet tactical formations, centering on the Company Team or Battalion Task Force between 1979 to 1982

[previewyoutube=MoHg_htAezg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Combat Mission Cold War [/b]is set in the tipping-point years of a conflict that gripped the world for 45 years. Between 1979-1982, both the NATO and Soviet Warsaw Pact militaries began the shift away from industrialized warfare of the early 20th century and towards the modern digital battlefield of today. 
Combat Mission Cold War simulates several “what if” conflict scenarios between US and Soviet forces centered on the strategic Fulda Gap and environs in West Germany.  

Combat Mission Cold War comes with [b]15 standalone scenarios[/b] set in the US V and VII Corp sectors of West Germany and [b]3 full length campaigns[/b]:

[list]
[*] The NTC Campaign:  Puts you in command of a US Army Company Team as it begins its rotation and trial by simulated fire against the premier Soviet style formation in the world.
[*] The US West German Campaign: Set in the southern Fulda Strategic Corridor between Fulda and Hanau (there are two versions of the US Campaign, 1982 and 1979 to allow players the opportunity to see and compare the differences in equipment between the two periods).
[*] The Soviet Campaign: Set north and east of Fulda, the Soviet Campaign follows the “Ride of the 120th Motor Rifle Regt” on the opening 48 hours of a fictional “what if” West German invasion.
[/list]

[b]FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tactical formations include highly detailed, historically accurate organizations, equipment and modeling of weapons effects that is second-to-none within the wargaming industry.
[*] Full suite of era-accurate tanks and mechanized infantry fighting vehicles, including many not available in any other Combat Mission franchise: (M48, M60 series of tanks, M150 TOW, M1 (105), T64, and T80, etc.
[*] Full suite of aircraft effects modeled on legendary platforms such as the iconic US F-4 Phantom and A-7 Corsair.
[*] Scenarios range from small platoon-based actions to large Battalion battles. 
[*] The Soviets bring with them their service workhorses, the infamous Mig-23/27, the Su-17, the rare but powerful Su-25 Frogfoot, and the well-known Mi-24 series gunship, including the first “Hind A” version and the famous “Hind D.
[*] Combat Mission Cold War also includes new and reoccurring battlefield innovations such as the introduction of Single and Dual-Purpose Improved Cluster Munitions delivered by both air and artillery support. 
[*] The early days of electronic warfare is modeled giving players a sense of the impact an encroaching digital age would have on warfare.
[/list]

[b]Combat Mission Cold War will be available on Steam and Matrix Games site on November 16th, and for the first time with the Slitherine PBEM multiplayer system. [/b]

notes.title: Combat Mission: Cold War - Release postponed
notes.content:
Combat Mission: Cold War has been officially postponed. 

We apologize for announcing late that we had to move the release date due to issues that prevent us from properly implementing the PBEM system for multiplayer. The new release date should be in September.

Battlefront is doing a great job trying to implement our PBEM system in the game, but obviously it's not that simple. We were convinced that we would be able to release by the end of July but we noticed that there were some problems in the build. Therefore we decided to give the developers a few more weeks to work on it.

It wasn't an easy decision, but it was a necessary one, to provide you with the best experience with Combat Mission Cold War.

We'll keep you updated as soon as we have more detailed information on the new date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39866586/267dcb42bfb024114086d92f6e94524d39d250b0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Combat Mission: Cold War will release July 22nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39866586/593388a7f844933f4b42c3c10bfb42a107247016.jpg[/img]

[b]Combat Mission: Cold War[/b] has a new release date: [b]July 22nd[/b]. 

The game will also be arriving with our[b] improved PBEM multiplayer system[/b] when it officially releases, allowing you and your friends to dive into the immersive multiplayer experience with minimal setup and co-ordination.

In case you missed the original announcement, Combat Mission is returning with a brand-new chapter set between 1979 and 1982. This was the tipping-point of a conflict that gripped the world for 45 years, the Cold War.

Developed by Battlefront, Combat Mission: Cold War comes with 15 standalone scenarios set in the US V and VII Corp sectors of West Germany and 3 full length campaigns. 

[b]We apologize for the delay, which was slightly longer than expected due to some internal factors caused by Covid[/b]. Robust multiplayer is something we feel strongly about, so we hope you will enjoy the enhanced experience PBEM system will offer and why we felt we had to delay the release to include it.

notes.title: Combat Mission Cold War is coming soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39866586/a6e4edd9eb8de08811a07d205d206af0db7688b6.jpg[/img]

[b]Combat Mission returns[/b] with a brand-new chapter set between 1979 and 1982. This was the tipping-point of a conflict that gripped the world for 45 years, the Cold War.

Both the NATO and Soviet Warsaw Pact militaries begin to move away from the industrialized warfare of the early 20th century and towards the modern digital battlefield of today.

Developed by Battlefront, [b]Combat Mission Cold War[/b] comes with 15 standalone scenarios set in the US V and VII Corp sectors of West Germany and 3 full length campaigns.

Prepare your best tactics and strategies: Cold War is [b]coming soon[/b], and things will be heating up when it arrives.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1551160/Combat_Mission_Cold_War/
